office_does: The auditor runs Ferry County's elections and handles recording, licensing and the county's accounts and payroll.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Dianna L. Galvan, in office since 2007, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Ferry County Auditor since 2007 and a former deputy auditor.
highlights: Her office runs county elections, recording and licensing [S3]
